condition.expression: no_confirmed_short AND vin_present AND NOT en_measured

next_steps.action: Measure LDO EN/CE pin voltage. Note: some LDOs are always-on (no EN pin); for those, skip to RULE_LDO_004_CHECK_LDO.

measure.where: LDO EN/CE pin (consult datasheet for pin number)
measure.expected: Active-high EN: at VIH when enabled. Active-low CE: <0.4 V when enabled.
measure.safety: Some LDOs are always-on (no EN). If so, this step is N/A.

interpretations.then: LDO is enabled. If output is still missing, suspect the LDO itself.
EC is not enabling the LDO. For always-on LDOs this is normal during sequencing; trace the EN signal.

next_steps.requires_info_note: Need LDO datasheet for EN pin number and polarity. Some LDOs are always-on and have no EN.
